sloka: एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया ।त्वाम् तु सत्यात् अतिक्रांतम् हनिष्यामि स बान्धवम् ॥४-३०-८१॥
transliteration: eka eva raṇe vālī śareṇa nihato mayā ।tvām tu satyāt atikrāṁtam haniṣyāmi sa bāndhavam ॥4-30-81॥

translations.english: 'The route by which Vali departed, killed by me has not been closed. O Sugriva you ought to abide by the pledge given. Do not follow the path of Vali.
